record_scope_reconstruction: Two named Lithuanian road posts Šumskas and Tverečius ceased operation from August18 2023. Official closure decision and separately published authority map establish both facility identities.

source_checks.finding: Interior ministry specifies two of six road posts closed August18; Šumskas had light vehicles, Tverečius light and empty freight vehicles. Other four initially remained.
Official directorate homepage links the independently downloaded interactive checkpoint map.
Inspected raw map markers pair named road/rail checkpoints with explicit LatLng values. Road Kybartai and railway Kybartai have different coordinates; mode identity retained.
Official administered-post roster confirms names and road-post addresses; coordinates come from linked map, not inferred address centroids.

sites.name: Šumskas road border checkpoint
sites.coordinate_method: Literal Google Maps LatLng in responsible border-checkpoint directorate interactive map, reordered longitude/latitude
sites.precision: Facility reference only; published decimal precision is not historical lane or obstruction survey accuracy.
sites.evidence_note: Named marker Šumsko automobilių kelių PKP (laikinai nutrauktas vykimas per PKP) is explicitly road or railway-station border control. Official directorate homepage links this interactive map. Marker is a facility reference, not exact historical lane.
